narr: A stationary boundary draped across the area in combination with an abundantly saturated environment set the stage for an isolated, but significant Flash Flooding event for portions of Northwest Georgia, with isolated flooding across central Georgia. With a deeply moist and tropical airmass, rainfall totals across NW Georgia reached 10-12, with isolated pockets within Chattooga county seeing up to 15+, prompting the issuance of a Flash Flood Emergency.
ev: Widespread significant flash flooding due to 8 to 12+ inches of rain in less than 12 hours across much of Chattooga County. Numerous roads were washed out or closed. At one point during the afternoon, the impacts triggered a Flash Flood Emergency for areas between Lyerly, Summerville, and James H Floyd State Park.
